about: Scripts the load order's records attach that no archive and no loose file in the game's Data folder carries: the mod or the DLC names a script it never shipped. The game skips them, so they do nothing. scripts/dev/Build-CrimeTable.py stops when a folder lacks any other attached script, because a folder missing scripts (the box with some archives and not the rest) would call each one it lacks one that cannot run (#3105). When the load order changes, measure again on a PC with the game: python scripts/dev/Audit-PapyrusEvents.py --json <file>, then every plugin's missingScripts.
